# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with baseline biomarker = -999 (QC failure)
df_valid = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df_valid.loc[df_valid.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute response rate by site
table = df_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)
